template_data.lead_html: Your SAM registration expired. You didn't notice. The CO did.

rows.what_html: We pull up SAM.gov together — expired 60 days ago, or NAICS codes don't match what they're selling
No alert, no email, no flag — the system quietly drops you from the eligible vendor pool
RFQs skipped, recompetes missed — all while ineligible, all without anyone telling you

template_data.closer: THE LICENSE THAT LAPSES SILENTLY COSTS THE MOST.
